title: TẦNG 3 – GIỚI TỪ VỊ TRÍ & MẠO TỪ (a / an / the)
target_audience: Học viên TOEIC Writing mất gốc

prepositions.in: Bên trong (không gian kín, trong phòng, trong hộp...)
prepositions.on: Bên trên (tiếp xúc bề mặt: trên bàn, trên tường, trên sàn...)
prepositions.at: Tại một điểm cụ thể (at the desk, at the door, at the station)
prepositions.near: Gần (không nhất thiết phải sát cạnh)

articles.a: Một (dùng trước danh từ đếm được số ít, bắt đầu bằng phụ âm)
articles.an: Một (dùng trước danh từ đếm được số ít, bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm: u, e, o, a, i)
articles.the: Cái/Con/Người... (dùng cho danh từ đã xác định, cả hai người nói/nghe đều biết đang nói về cái gì)

exercises.question: There is ___ cup ___ the table.
exercises.answer: There is a cup on the table.
exercises.explanation: 'a' vì 'cup' là danh từ đếm được số ít chưa xác định. 'on' vì cái cốc nằm trên bề mặt bàn.

exercises.question: ___ man is sitting ___ the desk.
exercises.answer: A man is sitting at the desk.
exercises.explanation: 'A' vì nhắc đến một người đàn ông chung chung. 'at' dùng cho vị trí ngồi tại bàn làm việc.

exercises.question: She has ___ apple ___ her bag.
exercises.answer: She has an apple in her bag.
exercises.explanation: 'an' đứng trước nguyên âm 'a'. 'in' vì quả táo nằm bên trong túi.

exercises.question: ___ dog is sleeping ___ the floor.
exercises.answer: A dog is sleeping on the floor.
exercises.explanation: 'A' dog (một con chó). 'on' dùng cho bề mặt sàn nhà (the floor).

exercises.question: There is ___ car parked ___ front of the house.
exercises.answer: There is a car parked in front of the house.
exercises.explanation: 'a' car (một chiếc xe). Cụm giới từ cố định: 'in front of' (phía trước).

exercises.question: Look at ___ bird ___ the tree.
exercises.answer: Look at the bird in the tree.
exercises.explanation: 'the' vì người nói đang chỉ vào một con chim cụ thể. 'in' dùng cho vị trí trên cành cây.

exercises.question: He is reading ___ book ___ the room.
exercises.answer: He is reading a book in the room.
exercises.explanation: 'a' book (một quyển sách bất kỳ). 'in' vì ở bên trong căn phòng.

exercises.question: ___ picture is hanging ___ the wall.
exercises.answer: A picture is hanging on the wall.
exercises.explanation: 'A' picture (một bức tranh). 'on' vì treo trên bề mặt tường.

exercises.question: There is ___ umbrella ___ the door.
exercises.answer: There is an umbrella near the door.
exercises.explanation: 'an' đứng trước nguyên âm 'u'. 'near' (gần) chỉ vị trí tương đối so với cánh cửa.

exercises.question: They are waiting ___ ___ bus stop.
exercises.answer: They are waiting at the bus stop.
exercises.explanation: 'at' dùng cho một địa điểm cụ thể. 'the' vì trạm xe buýt này đã được xác định ở khu vực đó.

exercises.question: I see ___ cat ___ the chair.
exercises.answer: I see a cat under the chair.
exercises.explanation: 'a' cat (một con mèo). 'under' (bên dưới) là giới từ vị trí cơ bản.

exercises.question: ___ computer is ___ the desk.
exercises.answer: The computer is on the desk.
exercises.explanation: 'The' vì máy tính là vật thể cụ thể đang được nhắc đến. 'on' vì nó nằm trên bàn.

exercises.question: She puts ___ pen ___ the box.
exercises.answer: She puts a pen in the box.
exercises.explanation: 'a' pen (một cây bút). 'in' vì đặt vào bên trong hộp.

exercises.question: There is ___ lamp next ___ the bed.
exercises.answer: There is a lamp next to the bed.
exercises.explanation: 'a' lamp (một cái đèn). Cụm giới từ 'next to' (bên cạnh).

exercises.question: ___ teacher is standing ___ the board.
exercises.answer: The teacher is standing near the board.
exercises.explanation: 'The' teacher (người giáo viên cụ thể của lớp). 'near' (gần) bảng.

exercises.question: He has ___ idea ___ his mind.
exercises.answer: He has an idea in his mind.
exercises.explanation: 'an' trước nguyên âm 'i'. 'in' dùng cho suy nghĩ bên trong đầu.

exercises.question: ___ woman is standing ___ the bus.
exercises.answer: A woman is standing near the bus.
exercises.explanation: 'A' woman (một người phụ nữ). 'near' (gần) chiếc xe buýt.

exercises.question: There is ___ window ___ the left.
exercises.answer: There is a window on the left.
exercises.explanation: 'a' window (một cửa sổ). Cụm cố định 'on the left' (bên trái).

exercises.question: Please put ___ documents ___ the folder.
exercises.answer: Please put the documents in the folder.
exercises.explanation: 'the' documents (tài liệu đã xác định). 'in' (vào trong) bìa hồ sơ.

exercises.question: ___ clock is ___ the wall.
exercises.answer: A clock is on the wall.
exercises.explanation: 'A' clock (một cái đồng hồ). 'on' (trên bề mặt tường).

exercises.question: I have ___ meeting ___ the office.
exercises.answer: I have a meeting in the office.
exercises.explanation: 'a' meeting (một cuộc họp). 'in' (bên trong) văn phòng.

exercises.question: ___ chair is ___ front of the desk.
exercises.answer: The chair is in front of the desk.
exercises.explanation: 'The' chair (chiếc ghế cụ thể của cái bàn). 'in' (nằm trong cụm in front of).

exercises.question: He works ___ ___ hospital.
exercises.answer: He works in a hospital.
exercises.explanation: 'in' (bên trong). 'a' hospital (một bệnh viện chung chung).

exercises.question: There is ___ apple ___ the basket.
exercises.answer: There is an apple in the basket.
exercises.explanation: 'an' apple. 'in' (bên trong giỏ).

exercises.question: ___ keys are ___ the table.
exercises.answer: The keys are on the table.
exercises.explanation: 'The' keys (chìa khóa đã xác định). 'on' (trên bề mặt bàn).

exercises.question: Some people are walking ___ ___ street.
exercises.answer: Some people are walking on the street.
exercises.explanation: 'on' dùng cho bề mặt đường phố. 'the' street vì con đường trong ngữ cảnh bức ảnh là cụ thể.

exercises.question: ___ manager is standing behind ___ counter.
exercises.answer: The manager is standing behind the counter.
exercises.explanation: 'The' manager và 'the' counter vì cả hai đều là đối tượng xác định trong ngữ cảnh bức tranh TOEIC.

exercises.question: A monitor is placed next ___ ___ keyboard.
exercises.answer: A monitor is placed next to the keyboard.
exercises.explanation: Cụm 'next to' (bên cạnh). 'the' keyboard vì bàn phím đi kèm cụ thể với màn hình đó.

exercises.question: There are some boxes ___ ___ corner of the room.
exercises.answer: There are some boxes in the corner of the room.
exercises.explanation: 'in' dùng cho góc bên trong căn phòng. 'the' corner là góc cụ thể.

exercises.question: ___ passengers are waiting ___ the platform.
exercises.answer: The passengers are waiting on the platform.
exercises.explanation: 'The' hành khách (đã xác định trong ảnh). 'on' the platform (trên nền sân ga).

exercises.question: She is holding ___ folder ___ her left hand.
exercises.answer: She is holding a folder in her left hand.
exercises.explanation: 'a' folder (một tập hồ sơ). 'in' her hand (trong tay).

exercises.question: ___ plants are arranged ___ a row.
exercises.answer: The plants are arranged in a row.
exercises.explanation: 'The' plants (các chậu cây trong ảnh). 'in a row' (thành một hàng) là cụm cố định.

exercises.question: A projector is mounted ___ ___ ceiling.
exercises.answer: A projector is mounted on the ceiling.
exercises.explanation: 'on' dùng cho bề mặt trần nhà. 'the' ceiling (trần nhà của căn phòng đó).

exercises.question: ___ vehicle is parked ___ front of the building.
exercises.answer: A vehicle is parked in front of the building.
exercises.explanation: 'A' vehicle (một chiếc xe). 'in front of' (phía trước) tòa nhà.

exercises.question: They are having ___ discussion ___ the table.
exercises.answer: They are having a discussion at the table.
exercises.explanation: 'a' discussion (một cuộc thảo luận). 'at' the table (ngồi tại bàn để làm việc/họp).

exercises.question: There is ___ empty seat next to ___ window.
exercises.answer: There is an empty seat next to the window.
exercises.explanation: 'an' empty seat (chỗ trống, bắt đầu bằng nguyên âm e). 'the' window (cửa sổ cụ thể).

exercises.question: ___ pedestrian is crossing ___ street.
exercises.answer: A pedestrian is crossing the street.
exercises.explanation: 'A' pedestrian (một người đi bộ). 'the' street (con đường cụ thể đang băng qua).

exercises.question: Some tools are left ___ ___ ground.
exercises.answer: Some tools are left on the ground.
exercises.explanation: 'on' the ground (trên mặt đất). 'the' ground luôn dùng mạo từ the.

exercises.question: ___ whiteboard is located behind ___ speaker.
exercises.answer: A whiteboard is located behind the speaker.
exercises.explanation: 'A' whiteboard (một cái bảng trắng). 'the' speaker (người thuyết trình đã xác định).

exercises.question: She is looking at ___ poster ___ the wall.
exercises.answer: She is looking at a poster on the wall.
exercises.explanation: 'a' poster (một tấm áp phích). 'on' the wall (trên bề mặt tường).

exercises.question: ___ bicycle is leaning against ___ fence.
exercises.answer: A bicycle is leaning against the fence.
exercises.explanation: 'A' bicycle (một chiếc xe đạp). 'the' fence (hàng rào cụ thể trong ảnh).

exercises.question: There is ___ shadow ___ the building.
exercises.answer: There is a shadow near the building.
exercises.explanation: 'a' shadow (một bóng râm). 'near' the building (gần tòa nhà).

exercises.question: ___ customers are standing ___ line.
exercises.answer: The customers are standing in line.
exercises.explanation: 'The' khách hàng (đang đợi). 'in line' (xếp hàng) là cụm cố định không dùng mạo từ.

exercises.question: He is pouring water into ___ glass ___ the table.
exercises.answer: He is pouring water into a glass on the table.
exercises.explanation: 'a' glass (một cái ly). 'on' the table (trên bàn).

exercises.question: ___ documents are scattered ___ the desk.
exercises.answer: The documents are scattered on the desk.
exercises.explanation: 'The' documents (tài liệu xác định). 'on' the desk (nằm rải rác trên bàn).

exercises.question: They are sitting ___ ___ shade of the tree.
exercises.answer: They are sitting in the shade of the tree.
exercises.explanation: 'in' the shade (bên trong bóng râm - cụm cố định). 'the' shade (bóng râm của cái cây cụ thể đó).

exercises.question: ___ shelf is filled with ___ books.
exercises.answer: The shelf is filled with books.
exercises.explanation: 'The' shelf (cái kệ cụ thể). Không dùng mạo từ trước danh từ số nhiều 'books' nói chung.

exercises.question: There is ___ bridge over ___ river.
exercises.answer: There is a bridge over the river.
exercises.explanation: 'a' bridge (một cây cầu). 'the' river (con sông cụ thể ở khu vực đó).

exercises.question: ___ worker is fixing ___ equipment.
exercises.answer: A worker is fixing the equipment.
exercises.explanation: 'A' worker (một công nhân). 'the' equipment (thiết bị cụ thể đang được sửa).

exercises.question: She places ___ notebook ___ her laptop.
exercises.answer: She places a notebook near her laptop.
exercises.explanation: 'a' notebook (một cuốn sổ). 'near' (gần) máy tính xách tay của cô ấy.

exercises.question: ___ items have been displayed ___ the storefront window.
exercises.answer: The items have been displayed in the storefront window.
exercises.explanation: 'The' items (các món hàng cụ thể). 'in' the window (nằm bên trong tủ kính trưng bày).

exercises.question: ___ audience is seated ___ the auditorium.
exercises.answer: The audience is seated in the auditorium.
exercises.explanation: 'The' audience (khán giả tập thể). 'in' the auditorium (bên trong hội trường).

exercises.question: A potted plant is situated ___ ___ corner of the office.
exercises.answer: A potted plant is situated in the corner of the office.
exercises.explanation: 'in the corner' (trong góc phòng). 'the' corner (góc cụ thể của văn phòng).

exercises.question: ___ staircase leads down ___ the basement.
exercises.answer: The staircase leads down to the basement.
exercises.explanation: 'The' staircase (cầu thang cụ thể). 'to' chỉ hướng đi tới tầng hầm (the basement).

exercises.question: An extension cord is plugged ___ ___ wall outlet.
exercises.answer: An extension cord is plugged into the wall outlet.
exercises.explanation: Cắm vào: 'plugged into'. 'the' wall outlet (ổ cắm cụ thể trên tường).

exercises.question: ___ merchandise is arranged neatly ___ the shelves.
exercises.answer: The merchandise is arranged neatly on the shelves.
exercises.explanation: 'The' merchandise (hàng hóa không đếm được). 'on' the shelves (trên bề mặt các kệ).

exercises.question: A sign is suspended ___ ___ ceiling.
exercises.answer: A sign is suspended from the ceiling.
exercises.explanation: Treo từ trên xuống dùng giới từ 'from'. 'the' ceiling (trần nhà).

exercises.question: ___ scaffolding has been erected ___ the building.
exercises.answer: The scaffolding has been erected around the building.
exercises.explanation: 'The' scaffolding (giàn giáo). 'around' (xung quanh) tòa nhà.

exercises.question: Some commuters are waiting ___ ___ intersection.
exercises.answer: Some commuters are waiting at the intersection.
exercises.explanation: 'at' dùng cho điểm giao cắt (ngã tư). 'the' intersection (ngã tư cụ thể).

exercises.question: ___ boat is tied ___ the pier.
exercises.answer: A boat is tied to the pier.
exercises.explanation: 'A' boat (một chiếc thuyền). Cột vào đâu dùng 'to', 'the' pier (bến tàu cụ thể).

exercises.question: A rug covers part ___ ___ floor.
exercises.answer: A rug covers part of the floor.
exercises.explanation: Một phần của: 'part of'. 'the' floor (sàn nhà luôn dùng the).

exercises.question: ___ articles of clothing are hanging ___ a rack.
exercises.answer: The articles of clothing are hanging on a rack.
exercises.explanation: 'The' articles (các món đồ cụ thể). 'on' a rack (trên một cái giá treo).

exercises.question: A lamp casts ___ shadow ___ the wall.
exercises.answer: A lamp casts a shadow against the wall.
exercises.explanation: Đổ bóng lên tường: 'casts a shadow against/on'. 'the' wall.

exercises.question: ___ documents have been organized ___ alphabetical order.
exercises.answer: The documents have been organized in alphabetical order.
exercises.explanation: 'The' documents. 'in alphabetical order' (theo thứ tự chữ cái - cụm cố định không có mạo từ).

exercises.question: Water is flowing ___ ___ fountain.
exercises.answer: Water is flowing from the fountain.
exercises.explanation: Chảy ra từ: 'from'. 'the' fountain (đài phun nước cụ thể).

exercises.question: ___ path winds ___ the forest.
exercises.answer: A path winds through the forest.
exercises.explanation: 'A' path (một con đường nhỏ). 'through' (xuyên qua) khu rừng (the forest).

exercises.question: A presentation is being projected ___ ___ screen.
exercises.answer: A presentation is being projected onto the screen.
exercises.explanation: Chiếu lên bề mặt: 'onto' hoặc 'on'. 'the' screen (màn hình chiếu cụ thể).

exercises.question: ___ branches extend ___ the roof of the house.
exercises.answer: The branches extend over the roof of the house.
exercises.explanation: 'The' branches (các cành cây). 'over' (vươn qua, phủ lên trên không chạm) mái nhà.

exercises.question: Several passengers are boarding ___ airplane ___ the gate.
exercises.answer: Several passengers are boarding the airplane at the gate.
exercises.explanation: Lên máy bay (đã xác định): 'boarding the airplane'. Tại cổng: 'at the gate'.

exercises.question: ___ bricks are stacked ___ top of each other.
exercises.answer: The bricks are stacked on top of each other.
exercises.explanation: 'The' bricks (những viên gạch). Cụm 'on top of' (chồng lên nhau).

exercises.question: A row of trees provides shade ___ ___ walkway.
exercises.answer: A row of trees provides shade along the walkway.
exercises.explanation: Dọc theo: 'along'. 'the' walkway (lối đi bộ cụ thể).

exercises.question: ___ vendor is standing ___ his cart.
exercises.answer: The vendor is standing behind his cart.
exercises.explanation: 'The' vendor (người bán hàng rong). 'behind' (đứng phía sau xe đẩy để bán).

exercises.question: A safety rail runs ___ ___ edge of the cliff.
exercises.answer: A safety rail runs along the edge of the cliff.
exercises.explanation: Chạy dọc theo: 'runs along'. 'the' edge (rìa vách đá).

exercises.question: ___ construction equipment is parked ___ the site.
exercises.answer: The construction equipment is parked at the site.
exercises.explanation: 'The' equipment (thiết bị không đếm được). 'at' the site (tại công trường).

exercises.question: Some cables are running ___ ___ floor under the desks.
exercises.answer: Some cables are running across the floor under the desks.
exercises.explanation: Chạy ngang qua: 'across'. 'the' floor (sàn nhà).
